text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. Vodka suddenly showed up with a massive nosebleed!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my head's spinning...
Pardon the intrusion, Trainer...
I hastily wiped away the blood, and everything ended without further trouble, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Good grief, that was one rough ordeal...
choice_data_list: Did you get into a brawl?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I ain't doing that.
Why on Valentine's Day of all days...
choice_data_list: Then did you eat too much chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I got a ton, but I ain't eating 'em.
I appreciate the thought, but I'll just pass 'em along to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I made it in the cooking room for ya.
Chocolates for the Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what face they'll make when they eat this.
Will they tell me it's delicious?
And then...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, come on~ Don't praise me that much. Stop making goo-goo eyes at me..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, you don't have to say 'thank you'...
This was just my way of... Urgh!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Boo-hoo!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In other words!! A brawl!!
This is the result of a fierce fistfight!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, won't happen again!
Don't worry, the other guy didn't have a scratch on 'em!

They had a "fierce fistfight," yet they're unscathed...
I don't quite get it, but it seems there's no problem then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, I went ahead and made
some chocolates for you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wanna try some? Well, true to my style,
it's got a wild and bitter taste, though.
Opening it up—inside were cute chocolates arranged neatly by Black.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Th-This is kind of awkward. I'm not really used to this sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just eat it already. You don't have to keep
staring at me and the chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Th-This... this atmosphere is...
Just like earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Boo-hoo!!

Nosebleeds erupt once again,
throwing the Trainer's office into utter chaos.

The chocolate was delicious,
but it turned into quite the bloody Valentine.

The chocolate was delicious,
but it turned into quite the bloody Valentine.
On the way back...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry about that. Thanks for walking me back.
I mean... it's pretty pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To think that *I'm* feeling anemic.
If someone were to see me like this...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Vodka-san!
Vodka-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Please accept these handmade chocolates,
Vodka-san!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with this encirclement?

A huge crowd of Umamusume
have gathered here to see Vodka...
I have to push through this crowd and somehow get her safely back to the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should I do?
Normally I could shake them off, but right now...
choice_data_list: Do you still have that chocolate from earlier!?
You still have that chocolate from earlier!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh, the chocolates from before? If you mean the failed batches from when I made Trainer's, I have a few.
choice_data_list: Throw it up into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Into the sky?! Got it!!
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look alive, you bastards, here's a blessing from the heavens!
Catch it—!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Eeeeek!
Vodka-san's chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text: I want it, I want it~♪

The other Umamusume got distracted,
and the front suddenly opened up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of my Trainer!
A path opened right in front of us in an instant...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, you really saved my skin.
How do I put it, I've fallen for you all over ag—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No! A-anyway, let's just push through!

Breaking through the home stretch in a flash! It feels like
I was able to repay a little of the chocolate I received.
